items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: It was Jeff Riddick, Raymond Boyk, and myself. And we would play at the intermissions...

ctx.x: The show was in the group, it was some insurance company, you know, and they had a little show of their own, I mean, just people who worked for the company, you know, one guy to get up and sing, the other, a couple danced, and some guy, I could hear him talking to the panel, I'd like to play that bass, but I see that guy's left hand, I can't play that bass. So Jeff told him, he says, yeah, you think you can, eh? He says, you right-handed? He says, you go get that bass, you'll see. And he was surprised as hell…
Play it backwards, so he didn't have to change the bass bar and everything.
